headline: Gold and silver ease slightly today, still well below late-October levels
summary: Today's move is tiny: 24K gold is down ₹1 per gram (about 0.01%) from yesterday, and silver is down ₹100 per kg (about 0.06%). Over the last seven days the drop is much larger, with 24K gold down ₹667 (4.86%) and silver down ₹15,100 (7.74%). Since 26 October, gold has fallen about 8.46% and silver about 18.23%, with silver's ₹2,20,000 per kg high on that first day now well behind it. International prices have eased over this period, and a firmer US dollar against the rupee can also push local rates down, though these are possible drivers rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices are near the lower end of the last 26 days, so buyers who are not in a hurry may prefer to watch for a few more sessions before committing, while anyone buying for a fixed event can take comfort that rates are lower than they were a fortnight ago.
